title: Starbucks Rewards Segmenter
why: Starbucks Rewards records what members buy, when, where and through which channel. That is far richer than age and income, so segments can be built on behaviour and each one gets its own offer.
problem: A company treats its customers using broad demographic segments, resulting in inefficient campaigns. Develop an LLM-powered customer intelligence system that discovers meaningful behavioral segments from transaction and interaction data and recommends differentiated marketing strategies.
data_note: 2,500 Rewards members with 6 months of transactions and app activity (sample data).

steps.detail: Visits, spend, time of day, mobile orders, food, offers
Recency, frequency, monetary plus 5 habit features
Standardise, then PCA to 2 dimensions for the map
K-means++ for k = 3 to 7, pick by silhouette
Check that segments differ in value and offer response
Rule-based names; AI analyst can rename
Compare old demographic groups with new segments

questions: Describe each segment like a person
Which segment is most valuable to grow?
Suggest a campaign for the weakest segment
Why are demographic segments worse here?
author: K Mohan Kumar
